investmentThesis.label: Product
investmentThesis.title: A governed world-information layer is already live
investmentThesis.statement: GlobalDeets operates as a source-first world desk with live news, place context, public knowledge, webcams, and an evidence-governance layer.
investmentThesis.proof: Current product surfaces + governed source registry + Coverage & Evidence Observatory.

investmentThesis.label: Platform
investmentThesis.title: The estate is now visible as an operating system, not a logo wall
investmentThesis.statement: Every active zone in the estate is represented in one health contract with real availability evidence, GlobalDeets first and Culture Sherpa prominent; unknown, blocked, and stale states are exposed instead of implied healthy.
investmentThesis.proof: Scheduled production probes + Cloudflare inventory + estate-health contract.

investmentThesis.label: Execution
investmentThesis.title: The diagnostic layer is consumable by both humans and agents
investmentThesis.statement: Mission Control derives its diagnostics queue from evidence and exposes priority, severity, business impact, ownership, age, escalation class, and next action for humans and agents.
investmentThesis.proof: Diagnostics contract derived from probe, history, and inventory evidence + sortable Mission Control queue.
